storyBlocks.text: A Happy People seminar is not an afternoon where you lean back and try to stay awake for three hours. You take part.
We talk with each other, we laugh, we listen, we ask questions, and sometimes we come across subjects you may never really have stopped to think about.

Psychology, spirituality, history, archaeology, human beliefs and personal stories come together, not to tell you what you should believe, but to explore together what we know, what we think we know, and what we can learn from each other when we look for a moment through someone else's eyes.
Maybe you discover a new perspective, or you recognize something from your own life in someone else's story. Or you simply have a lovely afternoon in Amersfoort.

eventBlocks.text: The date will follow, and so will the ticket price.
Come as you are, with your own background, with your own questions, or with no answers at all.
